Character.Name: Switchman
Character.Description: Switchman is the Field lead of the Black Rail Compact, working the freight lines under the industrial quarter. sets the crew plan and gives every member a clear way out. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: blackened rail armor with burgundy panels and signal-red lenses.
Character.Title: Field lead

Character.Name: Coupler
Character.Description: Coupler is the Quartermaster of the Black Rail Compact, working the freight lines under the industrial quarter. keeps the crew supplied and knows which kit can be repaired in the field. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: blackened rail armor with burgundy panels and signal-red lenses.
Character.Title: Quartermaster

Character.Name: Sleeper
Character.Description: Sleeper is the Pathfinder of the Black Rail Compact, working the freight lines under the industrial quarter. reads routes, sightlines, and exits before the rest of the crew arrives. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: blackened rail armor with burgundy panels and signal-red lenses.
Character.Title: Pathfinder

Character.Name: Brake
Character.Description: Brake is the Riflehand of the Black Rail Compact, working the freight lines under the industrial quarter. holds a steady lane and calls out changing enemy positions. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: blackened rail armor with burgundy panels and signal-red lenses.
Character.Title: Riflehand

Character.Name: Crosstie
Character.Description: Crosstie is the Bulwark of the Black Rail Compact, working the freight lines under the industrial quarter. takes the exposed approach so lighter crew members can reposition. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: blackened rail armor with burgundy panels and signal-red lenses.
Character.Title: Bulwark

Character.Name: Ballast
Character.Description: Ballast is the Mechanic of the Black Rail Compact, working the freight lines under the industrial quarter. keeps radios, doors, lifts, and improvised tools working under pressure. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: blackened rail armor with burgundy panels and signal-red lenses.
Character.Title: Mechanic

Character.Name: Spur
Character.Description: Spur is the Medic of the Black Rail Compact, working the freight lines under the industrial quarter. stabilizes injured crew and refuses to leave anyone behind. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: blackened rail armor with burgundy panels and signal-red lenses.
Character.Title: Medic

Character.Name: Axle
Character.Description: Axle is the Marksman of the Black Rail Compact, working the freight lines under the industrial quarter. spots threats early and shares a clean shot with the rest of the team. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: blackened rail armor with burgundy panels and signal-red lenses.
Character.Title: Marksman

Chatter.Description: Custom event chatter for Switchman. short dispatch calls with platform, track, and timing details.
Spawned: Switchman, Field lead, reporting from the freight lines under the industrial quarter.
WakeUp: Eyes up. Black Rail Compact still has work to finish.
Attacking: Switchman taking the field lead lane. the line stays open.
Chasing: Keep my signal. I'm pushing them toward the the freight lines under the industrial quarter.
Waiting: Holding position. Check your route before you move.
FriendDied: We lost one of ours. Mark the spot; the rest of us keep moving.
EnemyDown: Switchman confirms one hostile down. Watch the next angle.
Wounded: Switchman is hit! Still moving; get me behind cover!
Died: Tell the crew I made it this far with them.
Chatter.Name: Switchman - Black Rail Compact combat chatter
